lines.zh: 我走的不是路，是根。
lines.en: What I walk with is not feet but roots.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，土里就多一条须。
lines.en: Each step leaves another root in the soil.

lines.zh: 我的走法，是把整片地往前推。
lines.en: My way of walking is pushing the ground forward.

lines.zh: 根拔出来时，带出一串泥。
lines.en: Pulling a root up brings a string of mud.

lines.zh: 身后那圈草，全都变了色。
lines.en: The ring of grass behind me has changed color.

lines.zh: 我沉，走起来像地震前的闷响。
lines.en: I am heavy; I walk like a quake before it comes.

lines.zh: 根须拉着我，往有尸体的方向去。
lines.en: My roots pull me toward where bodies lie.

lines.zh: 我一站住，就不太想再走。
lines.en: Once I stand still, I seldom wish to move again.

lines.zh: 路过的兔子，被我的根缠住了。
lines.en: A passing rabbit is tangled in my roots.

lines.zh: 我踩过的石头，缝里长了菌伞。
lines.en: Mushrooms sprout from the stones I tread.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我脚下在渗。
lines.en: Do not follow close; something seeps beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我走到哪，那片林地就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever I go, that patch of woodland follows.

lines.zh: 这具身体走了七条命那么远。
lines.en: This body has walked as far as seven lives.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，草就枯了。
lines.en: Where my shadow falls, the grass withers.

lines.zh: 我把根一条条拔起，再插下
lines.en: I lift my roots one by one, then plant them.

lines.zh: 前面有具尸体，我慢慢挪过去
lines.en: There is a body ahead; I shift toward it.

lines.zh: 我扎在原地，慢慢把根铺满这一带。
lines.en: I root myself and slowly fill the area with roots.

lines.zh: 二十五格之内，都是我。
lines.en: Everything within twenty-five blocks is me.

lines.zh: 我不动，可周围一直在变。
lines.en: I do not move, yet everything around me changes.

lines.zh: 数数我身上的菌伞，就知我吃过多少。
lines.en: Count my caps and you will know how much I have eaten.

lines.zh: 我在等土里的水渗到最深处。
lines.en: I wait for the water in the soil to seep deep.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫在我指缝里做窝。
lines.en: A beetle is nesting between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把这一片整理成花园。
lines.en: I am tidying this stretch into a garden.

lines.zh: 根须在地下互相打招呼。
lines.en: My roots greet one another underground.

lines.zh: 我坐着，脚下的砖就软了。
lines.en: I sit, and the bricks beneath me soften.

lines.zh: 这地方从前是村子。
lines.en: This place was a village once.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把空气弄得潮湿。
lines.en: My breathing makes the air damp.

lines.zh: 七条命在我肚子里响。
lines.en: Seven lives are stirring in my belly.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，土会替我做梦。
lines.en: I need no sleep; the soil dreams for me.

lines.zh: 我一安静，蘑菇就长得快。
lines.en: When I am quiet, the mushrooms grow quickly.

lines.zh: 我数着半径里新长出的菌盖
lines.en: I count the caps newly grown within my radius.

lines.zh: 有水从我的指缝漏下去
lines.en: Water seeps down through my fingers.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，从前是别人的家。
lines.en: Where you stand was someone's home.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，根还在往下扎。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you while my roots keep digging.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的须了，我感觉到了。
lines.en: You stepped on a root. I felt it.

lines.zh: 我在想，你适不适合做第八个。
lines.en: I am wondering if you suit being the eighth.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我这圈里，就别走了。
lines.en: Your shadow fell inside my ring; stay a while.

lines.zh: 我不缺眼睛，我缺会走路的宿主。
lines.en: I lack no eyes; I lack a host that walks.

lines.zh: 你看这片蘑菇，都是我养的。
lines.en: See these mushrooms? I raised them all.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上，已经带着我的孢子。
lines.en: My spores are already on your boots.

lines.zh: 别摸那些白丝，它们会回摸你。
lines.en: Do not touch the white threads; they touch back.

lines.zh: 你闻到的甜味，是腐肉在发。
lines.en: That sweetness you smell is carrion blooming.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种眼神，是来找人的。
lines.en: I know that look. You came looking for someone.

lines.zh: 你背后那棵树上，也长着我的东西。
lines.en: The tree behind you carries my growth too.

lines.zh: 砍进我的肉，刀口立刻长出丝。
lines.en: The blade cuts my flesh, and threads grow in the cut.

lines.zh: 我疼，但根没有松。
lines.en: It hurts, but my roots hold.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍断了我三根须。
lines.en: That cut severed three of my roots.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下的东西，落地还在爬。
lines.en: What falls off me keeps crawling on the ground.

lines.zh: 你砍的是外层，里面还有一层。
lines.en: You cut the outer layer; another lies beneath.

lines.zh: 伤口会变成一朵新的菌伞。
lines.en: The wound will become a new mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 我退了，圈子却没退。
lines.en: I recoiled, but my ring did not.

lines.zh: 血溅在地上，立刻被吸干。
lines.en: The blood on the ground is drunk up at once.

lines.zh: 别以为砍断根就完了。
lines.en: Do not think cutting the root ends it.

lines.zh: 我记住了这一刀的位置。
lines.en: I have marked where that blow landed.

lines.zh: 把尸体留下，你可以空手走。
lines.en: Leave the body and you may walk away empty-handed.

lines.zh: 腐肉对我是香料。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is spice to me.

lines.zh: 那块生牛肉，比你的命值钱。
lines.en: That raw beef is worth more than your life.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟的，熟的不肯长。
lines.en: I do not eat cooked meat; it refuses to grow.

lines.zh: 你背上的那只羊，我已经闻到。
lines.en: I smell the sheep on your back.

lines.zh: 把桶里的牛奶倒了吧，我要桶。
lines.en: Pour out the milk; I want the bucket.

lines.zh: 骨头别扔，那是我搭架子的料。
lines.en: Do not throw the bones away; I build with them.

lines.zh: 你给我一具躯体，我给你一片园子。
lines.en: Give me one body, and I give you a garden.

lines.zh: 那些腐叶，比面包更合我意。
lines.en: Rotten leaves suit me better than bread.

lines.zh: 放下东西，退到圈外。
lines.en: Set it down and step outside the ring.

lines.zh: 我把你手里的鱼当种子。
lines.en: I take the fish in your hand for seed.

lines.zh: 食物落土，就归这片地了。
lines.en: Food that touches soil belongs to this land.

lines.zh: 别把好东西埋了，埋了也是我的。
lines.en: Do not bury good things; buried, they are still mine.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只是等你放下。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for you to set it down.

lines.zh: 那只羊留着，等我先扎根
lines.en: Keep that sheep; let me root first.

lines.zh: 你把桶放下，我会自己过去
lines.en: Set the bucket down; I will come to it.

lines.zh: 撞到我像撞一棵活树。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a living tree.

lines.zh: 我没退，你身后的草全折了。
lines.en: I did not budge; the grass behind you flattened.

lines.zh: 我的皮又厚又潮。
lines.en: My hide is thick and damp.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的护腿沾了菌液。
lines.en: That collision left fungal sap on your leggings.

lines.zh: 我身上的蘑菇被你撞掉两朵。
lines.en: You knocked two mushrooms off me.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，根会缠脚。
lines.en: Do not press against me; roots catch ankles.

lines.zh: 我只晃了晃，地却陷了。
lines.en: I merely swayed, and the ground gave way.

lines.zh: 你撞完就跑，鞋印里已经发芽。
lines.en: You ran off, and sprouts are already in your prints.

lines.zh: 我这一身，比你想象的重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than you imagine.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，你就站在我圈里了。
lines.en: Bump me again and you stand inside my ring.

lines.zh: 两株菌主靠近，根会先握在一起。
lines.en: Two hosts draw near, and their roots clasp first.

lines.zh: 我们不开花，我们把整片地铺开。
lines.en: We do not bloom; we unroll the whole field.

lines.zh: 她的圈比我的圆，我认了。
lines.en: Her ring is rounder than mine. I concede.

lines.zh: 我们中间那条线，谁也不越。
lines.en: Neither of us crosses the line between.

lines.zh: 并根之后，这片林子归我们。
lines.en: Once rooted together, this wood is ours.

lines.zh: 我们换孢子，像交换戒指。
lines.en: We trade spores the way others trade rings.

lines.zh: 她比我多两条命，话也更多。
lines.en: She carries two more lives, and talks more.

lines.zh: 两片菌毯相接处，隆起一道脊。
lines.en: Where our mats meet, a ridge rises.

lines.zh: 我们一起扎根，谁也不走。
lines.en: We root together, and neither leaves.

lines.zh: 等我们的根合上，就分不开了。
lines.en: Once our roots join, we cannot be parted.

lines.zh: 落下的东西，落地就算种下。
lines.en: Whatever falls is planted where it lands.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，我用根把东西卷过来。
lines.en: I do not bend; my roots curl around things.

lines.zh: 那袋种子撒了，正合我意。
lines.en: The spilled seed pouch suits me well.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的斧头，柄先发芽。
lines.en: The fallen axe sprouts from its handle first.

lines.zh: 我收东西慢，可从没漏下一件。
lines.en: I collect slowly, yet nothing has ever slipped past me.

lines.zh: 你的箭落进圈里，就别想再拿。
lines.en: Your arrow landed in my ring; forget it.

lines.zh: 我身下压着七件战利品。
lines.en: Seven trophies are pressed beneath me.

lines.zh: 铁器在我这儿会生锈，很快。
lines.en: Iron rusts quickly here with me.

lines.zh: 捡来的骨头，我都插成篱笆。
lines.en: The bones I gather, I plant as a fence.

lines.zh: 地上那摊血迹，我收下了。
lines.en: That bloodstain on the ground? I accept it.

lines.zh: 你走进二十五格，我就开始长你。
lines.en: You enter twenty-five blocks, and I begin growing you.

lines.zh: 我不追，我的圈会替我追。
lines.en: I do not chase; my ring chases for me.

lines.zh: 七条命之后，我对活物很敏感。
lines.en: After seven lives, I am sensitive to the living.

lines.zh: 你一停脚，根就从下面上来。
lines.en: The moment you stop, roots come up under you.

lines.zh: 我选中的，通常跑不掉。
lines.en: What I choose seldom escapes.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，让我的菌伞转向。
lines.en: Your footsteps turn my caps toward you.

lines.zh: 这片地里，只有你还站着。
lines.en: In this field, only you are still standing.

lines.zh: 我记住你落脚的那块土了。
lines.en: I remember the patch of soil you stepped on.

lines.zh: 你砍倒的树，正好给我当门。
lines.en: The tree you felled makes a fine gate for me.

lines.zh: 别站在边界上，那里最软。
lines.en: Do not stand on the boundary; it is softest there.

lines.zh: 我的根在地下，比你的腿快。
lines.en: My roots underground outrun your legs.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，可圈子越缩越小。
lines.en: You circle, and the circle keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 我不用看，土会把你的位置告诉我。
lines.en: I need not look; the soil tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 你砍断的须，另一端还在找你。
lines.en: The root you cut still searches at its other end.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边铺了一条软路。
lines.en: I have laid a soft path at your feet.

lines.zh: 你数着蘑菇走，它们都是我。
lines.en: You walk counting mushrooms. They are all me.

lines.zh: 这片林子的每棵树都替我看。
lines.en: Every tree in this wood watches for me.

lines.zh: 你往高处爬，根也往上爬。
lines.en: Climb high, and the roots climb too.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，传到我这边了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat reaches me through the ground.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头就会踩到我的东西。
lines.en: Do not look back; you will tread on my growth.

lines.zh: 根从土里抽出来，抽在你腿上。
lines.en: A root whips out of the soil and catches your leg.

lines.zh: 我抬手，带起一整片菌土。
lines.en: I raise a hand and lift a whole sheet of soil.

lines.zh: 这一掌不重，可它会生根。
lines.en: The blow is light, but it takes root.

lines.zh: 被我打过的地方，会长出东西。
lines.en: Things grow where I strike.

lines.zh: 我不必瞄准，我打的是这片地。
lines.en: I need not aim; I strike the ground itself.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的圈，就该挨这下。
lines.en: You stepped into my ring; this blow is owed.

lines.zh: 菌丝顺着伤口往里走。
lines.en: The mycelium follows the wound inward.

lines.zh: 我打完就退回去，继续扎根。
lines.en: I strike, withdraw, and root again.

lines.zh: 七条命的力气，一下给你。
lines.en: Seven lives' worth of strength in one blow.

lines.zh: 你倒下的位置，我早留好了。
lines.en: I have already saved the spot where you will fall.

lines.zh: 第七具尸体倒下时，我从它背后长出来。
lines.en: When the seventh body fell, I grew from behind it.

lines.zh: 我攒够了七条命，才配站起来。
lines.en: I gathered seven lives before I earned standing.

lines.zh: 那具壳杀到第七个，就空了。
lines.en: That husk killed its seventh and went hollow.

lines.zh: 我落地先扎根，再睁眼。
lines.en: I rooted first, then opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 第一圈菌毯，是我自己铺的。
lines.en: I laid the first ring of fungus myself.

lines.zh: 我从土里挤出时，草都让开了。
lines.en: When I pushed out of the soil, the grass gave way.

lines.zh: 孢子在我嘴里含了七天。
lines.en: The spores sat seven days in my mouth.

lines.zh: 出生的地方，现在已经没有路。
lines.en: There is no road left where I was born.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，村子就安静了。
lines.en: When I stood, the village went quiet.

lines.zh: 骨头在我脚下堆成台阶。
lines.en: Bones piled into steps beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 你烧掉一圈，我明天补两圈。
lines.en: Burn one ring, and I will regrow two.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，把落脚的地方压成坑。
lines.en: I fell and pressed my landing spot into a pit.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我正好喜欢湿。
lines.en: Water rises, and damp suits me fine.

lines.zh: 炸散的我，散在土里各自生根。
lines.en: Blown apart, my pieces root where they land.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我身上，像插了根枝。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me like a twig.

lines.zh: 魔法药水浇下来，我长得更好。
lines.en: That potion only watered me.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，就吃自己的根。
lines.en: When hungry, I eat my own roots.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，焦味传遍整片林。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; the burnt smell filled the wood.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，根还抓着一块土。
lines.en: I fell into the void with roots clutching soil.
